info.name: Mr. Deeds
info.plot: Longfellow Deeds è un pizzaiolo del New Hampshire, aspirante poeta. La sua vita cambia radicalmente grazie ad una ingente eredità lasciatagli da un lontano parente. Subito si avventano su di lui avvoltoi e giornalisti in cerca di scoop.

translations.overview: When Longfellow Deeds, a small-town pizzeria owner and poet, inherits $40 billion from his deceased uncle, he quickly begins rolling in a different kind of dough. Moving to the big city, Deeds finds himself besieged by opportunists all gunning for their piece of the pie. Babe, a television tabloid reporter, poses as an innocent small-town girl to do an exposé on Deeds.
translations.tagline: Don't let the fancy clothes fool you.
